The test image shows a green mango leaf with small round raised bumps/protrusions scattered along the leaf surface — matching perfectly with the Gall Midge reference images showing round blister-shaped galls on mango leaves.

Key observations:
- **Test image**: Green healthy-looking leaf with small round raised galls distributed across the leaf surface, most prominent along the margins
- **Gall Midge reference**: Identical pattern — round blister-shaped galls (brown-black at older stage) scattered on green leaves, same leaf shape and distribution pattern
- **Ruled out**: Sooty Mould (black coating), Anthracnose (dark lesions/brown spots), Cutting Weevil (curled/crumpled leaves with stripped edges)

The small round raised galls on the test leaf match the Gall Midge symptom description exactly: "round, blister-shaped galls approximately 2–3 mm in diameter on mango leaves."
